answer_1.quote: our goal is to propose a novel framework, i.e., LAPI (LLM-based Agent with a Professional Identity), which aims to enhance the effectiveness of LLM-based chatbots in serving as professional service agents, particularly in the context of medical Q&A services.
datasets: dataset collected from a reputable ophthalmology hospital [...] comprises 400 real-world patient inquiries

answer_2.quote: For non-LLM-based evaluation, we adopted ROUGE-L recall and precision as objective n-gram matching-based metrics.

answer_3.quote: For LLM-based evaluation, we employed G-EVAL, a state-of-the-art metric designed to assess various qualitative aspects of large language model outputs [...] G-EVAL has been shown to exhibit strong consistency with human evaluations
